questions.prompt: By demographers' estimates, roughly how many people have ever been born on Earth (counting everyone who has ever lived, up to 2022)?
questions.insight: The Population Reference Bureau estimates that today's roughly 8 billion people are only about 6.8 percent of everyone who has ever been born.

questions.prompt: Trade in goods and services (exports plus imports) was equal to what percentage of world GDP in 2024, according to the World Bank?
questions.insight: Exports of goods and services alone were 29.1% of world GDP in 2024.

questions.prompt: According to the Federation of American Scientists, roughly how many nuclear warheads existed worldwide (total inventory, including retired warheads awaiting dismantlement) at the start of 2026?
questions.insight: Russia and the United States together hold about 86 percent of the world's nuclear warhead inventory.

questions.prompt: What was the Arctic sea ice extent at its annual minimum in September 2025, in millions of square kilometers, according to the US National Snow and Ice Data Center?
questions.insight: That is 1.62 million km² below the 1981-2010 average minimum, roughly the size of Alaska.

questions.prompt: How many human cases of Guinea worm disease (dracunculiasis) were reported worldwide in 2024?
questions.insight: Guinea worm cases have fallen from about 890,000 in 1989 to only 15 in 2024, all in Chad and South Sudan.
